title: The Only Script you Ever Need  Huge library Obfuscator
features:
Roxerion is the all in one Roblox toolkit built for speed and simplicity. Browse a massive script library on the web, favorite what you want, and have it instantly ready inside the in game hub for one click execution. Live Sync keeps everything connected across devices, with universal scripts, game coverage, favorites, and frequent updates.

After you execute the script, you’ll be asked to enter a Link Code. Get your Link Code by visiting roxerion.com and you’ll find it there. Once linked, you can use the hub, browse the website, execute scripts from the site or directly in the hub, upload scripts, and control your game through the dashboard. Everything stays synced.

RoxGuard Obfuscator is available on the website at https://roxerion.com/obfuscation and via the Roxerion Discord bot.
